arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import *

# Test ROOT
print('Testing ROOT...')
r = ROOT()
print(f'ROOT instance: {r}')

# Test Auto
print('\\nTesting Auto...')
a = Auto('x')
print(f'Auto repr: {repr(a)}')

# Test Fill
print('\\nTesting Fill...')
f = Fill('missing', default='default_val')
print(f'Fill repr: {repr(f)}')

# Test Iter
print('\\nTesting Iter...')
i = Iter([1, 2, 3])
print(f'Iter repr: {repr(i)}')

# Test Let
print('\\nTesting Let...')
l = Let({'x': 'a'}, T['x'])
print(f'Let repr: {repr(l)}')

# Test Invoke
print('\\nTesting Invoke...')
def my_func(x):
    return x * 2
inv = Invoke(my_func, constants={'y': 10})
print(f'Invoke repr: {repr(inv)}')
print(f'Invoke constants: {inv.constants}')
print(f'Invoke consts (deprecated): {inv.consts}')

# Test Check __repr__
print('\\nTesting Check repr...')
c = Check(T['a'], type=int)
print(f'Check repr: {repr(c)}')

# Test Coalesce __repr__
print('\\nTesting Coalesce repr...')
co = Coalesce('a', 'b', 'c')
print(f'Coalesce repr: {repr(co)}')

# Test Inspect __repr__
print('\\nTesting Inspect repr...')
ins = Inspect('a.b')
print(f'Inspect repr: {repr(ins)}')

# Test Assign __repr__
print('\\nTesting Assign repr...')
asgn = Assign('x.y.z', 'value')
print(f'Assign repr: {repr(asgn)}')

# Test assign function
print('\\nTesting assign function...')
target = {'x': {'y': {'z': 'old'}}}
assign(target, 'x.y.z', 'new')
print(f'Target after assign: {target}')

print('\\nAll tests passed!')
"
